title: Discord keys checked, clearer hosted MCP answers
items: Saving Discord signature verification on an endpoint refuses a public key that is not 64 hex characters, from the dashboard, the API, the CLI, the SDKs and the MCP server alike, so a mistyped key no longer leaves an endpoint that verifies nothing

The hosted MCP server at webhooks.cc/mcp says so when a client still passes targetUrl to render_email or test_webhook_flow: nothing was posted there, and posting to your own URL needs the local server (npx -y @webhooks-cc/mcp)
